title: HOSOKAWAMICRON CORPORATION
content: HOSOKAWAMICRON CORPORATION is a Japanese powder-processing specialist supplying milling, mixing, drying, granulation, classification, and analysis solutions. These systems are relevant to aerogel raw-material handling, solids preparation, and process development where powder behavior must be controlled across laboratory and industrial workflows. Hosokawa Micron is a strong Equipment Materials listing for powder-centric upstream operations.
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
